messages.text:
BL-1758 — A greenfield target gets a launchable starter kit from the local swarmforgevc checkout - one install copies this checkout's own engine (swarmforge/scripts), git-hooks, handoff protocol, generic constitution, the mono-router pack and a generic role-prompt set into a target that has only a README, writes a conf recording the checkout and commit, and wires core.hooksPath; the swarm wrapper never fetches upstream's floating main (ruling A, recommended)
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: New feature file and one real choice: where a fresh target's engine, pack and prompts come from. FIRM whatever you pick: the engine and the pack a target receives come from the same place, so they always agree (the incompatible upstream engine was the worst of the gaps), and an install never touche…
